caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object, a basket or bowl with two scroll-shaped handles extending from either side. The basket appears to be made of glass or a reflective material, exhibiting an iridescent surface with shades of pale yellow, pink, blue, green, and lavender. The body of the basket is curved outward and has a flared rim, with each end terminating in a spiral scroll handle. The bowl sits atop a short, thick pedestal base, which is round with a slightly raised rim decorated with a series of ovals or circular shapes. The object is centered on a plain, tan background, bordered by a simple rectangular line near the edge of the page. Handwritten notes in pencil can be seen in the lower left and right corners, providing details such as “CAKE BASKET #18779-12 CASE 3. height about 3½"” and a signature with the date “Jan. 7th 1936,” along with the name Mary Sumner.
title: Cake Basket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
